## A. Extend gasoline model to dynamic harmonic regression

Revisit the weekly gasoline setup from week 10 and add ARIMA error structure as shown in [week11.R](week11.R).

::: {.callout-note}
## What to notice

- Why does adding ARIMA errors improve over pure harmonic regression?
- Which residual patterns remain after adding dynamics?
:::

## B. Convert half-hourly electricity to daily series

```r
vic_elec_daily <- vic_elec |>
  index_by(Date = date(Time)) |>
  summarise(
    Demand = sum(Demand) / 1e3,
    Temperature = max(Temperature),
    Holiday = any(Holiday)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Day_Type = case_when(
      Holiday ~ "Holiday",
      wday(Date) %in% 2:6 ~ "Weekday",
      TRUE ~ "Weekend"
    )
  )
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What to notice

- Understand each transformation and why daily aggregation is useful.
- Compare weekly and yearly seasonal patterns after aggregation.
:::

## C. Compare ETS, ARIMA, and DHR for electricity demand

```r
elec_fit <- vic_elec_daily |>
  model(
    ets = ETS(Demand),
    arima = ARIMA(log(Demand)),
    dhr = ARIMA(log(Demand) ~ Temperature + I(Temperature^2) +
      (Day_Type == "Weekday") +
      fourier(period = "year", K = 4))
  )

accuracy(elec_fit)
```

::: {.callout-note}
## What to notice

- Which model best captures temperature effects and calendar structure?
- Evaluate fit and residual diagnostics, not only training accuracy.
:::

## D. Build and forecast a 14-day scenario

```r
vic_elec_future <- new_data(vic_elec_daily, 14) |>
  mutate(
    Temperature = c(rep(32, 7), rep(25, 7)),
    Holiday = c(TRUE, rep(FALSE, 13)),
    Day_Type = case_when(
      Holiday ~ "Holiday",
      wday(Date) %in% 2:6 ~ "Weekday",
      TRUE ~ "Weekend"
    )
  )
```

Then run the forecast blocks in [week11.R](week11.R).
